kind: real QVAC 0.22.0 sdcpp-generation through production Runtime + Background + Jobs on macOS arm64 (24 GB); synthetic in-memory vault, AES-GCM protector; no phone/TLS in the loop

input.prompt: sea glass and soft morning fog

images: i06-background-0.jpg (light: 'sea glass and soft morning fog')

sdkFindings.plugins: The packaged worker only bundles plugins listed in qvac.config.json; sdcpp-generation had to be added (load failed with 'Plugin not found' after bundling).
sdkFindings.progress: diffusion().progressStream yields one tick per step (21 ticks for 20 steps), ~1.7 s/step at 512x768 on this Mac.
sdkFindings.cancel: cancel({modelId, kind:'diffusion'}) and cancel({operation:'inference', modelId}) did NOT interrupt generation in 0.22.0 (12/12 steps completed). unloadModel() during generation stopped it within ~1 s ('Job cancelled' at step 3), and a new load works afterwards. The companion therefore cancels by unloading its per-request model.
sdkFindings.timing: Model load ~10-11 s (cold), generation ~37-39 s for 512x768x20 steps, self-test (256x256x4) ~5 s including load.
sdkFindings.memory: SD 2.1 Q8_0 is 2.3 GB on disk; macOS free memory dropped by ~2.5 GB while loaded. SDXL Q4_0 (16 GB guidance) is refused as insufficient_memory on hosts with less than ~14.4 GB.

observations: Prompting 'no text' plus a negative prompt does not fully prevent text-like artefacts (the forest image shows faint pseudo-letters).
The 'dark' tone was only partly respected by SD 2.1 (bright green foreground).
